tasks.title: Formal monthly board meeting
tasks.description: Three-hour quorum: consent agenda, CEO report, exec session tail. You run the room.

tasks.title: Live audit committee session
tasks.description: Walk the control matrix with the audit chair — no async deck substitutes.

tasks.title: Comp committee live review
tasks.description: Approve option refreshes and exec pay bands in a recorded session.

tasks.title: Strategy deep-dive (full board)
tasks.description: Whiteboard TAM, pricing power, and the one bet you are doubling down on.

tasks.title: Crisis war room with board
tasks.description: Outage, PR flare, or churn spike — directors on Zoom until there is a plan.

tasks.title: Fundraise pricing committee
tasks.description: Term sheet math live — lead wants your ask, dilution, and use of proceeds on one slide.

tasks.title: CEO performance review
tasks.description: Lead director runs the session; you present goals, misses, and the recovery plan.

tasks.title: Independent executive session
tasks.description: Directors meet without management — you wait in the hall with coffee.

tasks.title: Customer proof session
tasks.description: Two reference CEOs join for thirty minutes; board asks the hard renewal questions.

tasks.title: IPO readiness board readout
tasks.description: S-1 timeline, dual-class debate, and banker roster — everyone leaves with owners.

tasks.title: Board earnings call prep
tasks.description: Script the quarter narrative with directors before the public call.

tasks.title: Buyback authorization vote
tasks.description: Model repurchase bands; board votes yes/no on the authorization size.

tasks.title: M&A live diligence review
tasks.description: Target deck, synergy ranges, and integration risks — partners want numbers, not vibes.

tasks.title: Succession tabletop
tasks.description: If you get hit by a bus — who runs product, who talks to investors?

tasks.title: ESG & investor day dry run
tasks.description: Full board attends the dress rehearsal for your investor day keynote.

tasks.title: Annual board retreat
tasks.description: Offsite with spouses optional, strategy mandatory — two days, one decision tree.

tasks.title: Workforce reduction board session
tasks.description: Severance bands, WARN timing, and comms script — board votes before people hear rumors.

tasks.title: Strategic partnership vote
tasks.description: Co-sell, resell, or OEM — directors want exclusivity and margin impact on the record.

tasks.title: Privacy & regulatory hearing
tasks.description: GC walks consent flows; audit chair asks what happens when a regulator calls.

tasks.title: AI governance charter vote
tasks.description: Model inventory, red-team cadence, and customer disclosure — board adopts the policy live.

tasks.title: Treasury & cash policy review
tasks.description: Idle cash, FX hedges, and whether you are over-indexed to T-bills vs growth bets.

tasks.title: Founder control & dual-class debate
tasks.description: Super-voting, sunset clauses, and what happens if you step back — tense but necessary.

tasks.title: Whistleblower hotline review
tasks.description: Closed session on open ethics tickets — no names in the minutes, full accountability in the room.

tasks.title: Activist response war room
tasks.description: 13D landed — board, bankers, and lawyers align on defense and white paper talking points.

tasks.title: Short-seller rebuttal session
tasks.description: Walk the report line-by-line; independents decide if you need an 8-K or a roadshow.

tasks.title: Stock split authorization vote
tasks.description: Ratio, record date, and retail narrative — board resolution before IR announces.

tasks.title: Index inclusion committee brief
tasks.description: Free float, liquidity, and passive flow math — chair wants to know passive ownership after add.

tasks.title: Segment reporting redesign
tasks.description: Break out product lines for the street — CFO and audit chair stress-test the new buckets.

tasks.title: Satellite office expansion vote
tasks.description: New city, seat count, and lease term — full board signs off before brokers get excited.

tasks.title: Conference keynote board review
tasks.description: Directors hear the big-stage talk early — kill the cringe slides before 5,000 strangers do.
